The home mountain of the Greek Gods is Mount Olympus.

To understand the concept of search engines using the provided analogy: Imagine you are looking for a specific recipe in a massive library. The library contains millions of books (websites), and each book has thousands of pages (web pages). Without a system to organize these books, finding the exact recipe would be like searching for a needle in a haystack. The library index (the search engine) acts as a catalog that tells you exactly which book to pick up and which page to turn to, saving you from having to read every single page in the entire library. This allows you to quickly locate the precise information you need among the vast amount of data available on the Internet.
